terminology.rule: M0-M9 are project acceptance checkpoints. M code never changes the P identity of a product.

milestones.name: Engineering Bootstrap
milestones.objective: Create a buildable/testable Windows+Linux software substrate; no capability Phase is admitted by M0 alone.

milestones.name: P1 Minimum Vertical Slice
milestones.objective: Run one Basic Flight synthetic vertical slice Source→Canonical→Context→Episode/Stage→World→representative metrics→Observation→Release→API→GUI on Windows and Linux.

milestones.name: P1 Basic Flight Complete
milestones.objective: Complete Basic Flight P1 capability plus the 32-item P1 foundation metric delivery batch and representative Golden evidence.

milestones.name: P1 Four-Training-Type Complete
milestones.name_cn: P1四类训练观测能力完整
milestones.objective: Complete P1 Basic/WVR/BVR/Strike observed-performance capability and all 116 executable P1 metrics; P1 formulas/semantics are production candidates.

milestones.name: P1 Longitudinal & Debrief Closure
milestones.objective: Close P1 aircraft/mission-system longitudinal trends, evidence-first debrief/analytics and historical replay without activating P4 human assessment.

milestones.name: P1 Product Qualification & Release
milestones.objective: Qualify P1 on mandatory Windows/Linux profiles, target workload, security/governance, packaging, upgrade/rollback and release acceptance.

milestones.name: P2 Attribution Activation
milestones.objective: Admit P2 Context Attribution & Normalization after identifiability, leakage, uncertainty and evidence gates are validated.

milestones.name: P3 Capability/Twin Activation
milestones.name_cn: P3能力模型/数字孪生启用
milestones.objective: Admit P3 capability models, aircraft twin revisions and model profiles with applicability/knowledge-time/model validation gates.

milestones.name: P4/P5 Training Assessment Activation
milestones.objective: Admit P4 individual/human-machine and P5 team/package/mission assessment with instructor, privacy, scope separation and longitudinal evidence gates.

milestones.name: P6 Joint/LVC & Predictive Activation
milestones.objective: Admit P6 Joint/LVC and forecast/counterfactual/recommendation products with fact/projection separation, external interoperability and approval gates.

ordering_rule: M0→M9 is the default program roadmap; controlled tailoring may change dates/parallelism but not code meanings without registry versioning.
relationship_rules: M and P are orthogonal: multiple M can be needed to complete one P capability.
WS spans M and P; completion of a WS task does not itself admit a P capability.
Stage never appears as a project progress checkpoint.
